scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && cross-env INPUT=experimental-goal-planner.html vite build && cross-env INPUT=coaching-dashboard.html vite build
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run test:scaffolds
scripts.start: concurrently --raw "cross-env NODE_ENV=development INPUT=experimental-goal-planner.html vite build --watch" "cross-env NODE_ENV=development INPUT=coaching-dashboard.html vite build --watch" "tsx watch main.ts"
